keyPhrases.text: OMG what a fun time I had
The audience was having a blast, whooping and hollering
gave the cast a standing ovation
something this entertaining doesn't need a deep dive

reasoning: Enthusiastic positive review with strong audience reaction indicators (standing ovation, whooping). Uses superlatives like 'OMG' and 'blast.' Clear recommendation implied by excitement and entertainment value. Falls in 4/5 range due to being more about fun/entertainment than artistic achievement.
